points.title: 童年启蒙
points.description: 1840年11月14日，克劳德·莫奈出生于法国勒阿弗尔的一个商人家庭。他的父亲希望他继承家族杂货生意，但莫奈从小就展现出对艺术的热爱。少年时期，他在勒阿弗尔的海滩上绘制风景画，以出售自己的素描为乐。1851年，当地画家欧仁·布丹(Eugène Boudin)发现了莫奈的才华，并鼓励他到户外作画，这一经历奠定了莫奈一生坚持户外写生的艺术理念。勒阿弗尔的港口、海岸风光成为他早期作品的重要主题。
points.descriptionEn: Claude Monet was born on November 14, 1840, in Le Havre, France, to a family of merchants. His father expected him to continue the family grocery business, but Monet showed an early passion for art. As a teenager, he drew landscapes on the beaches of Le Havre, selling his sketches for income. In 1851, local artist Eugène Boudin discovered Monet's talent and encouraged him to paint outdoors, an experience that established Monet's lifelong commitment to plein air painting. The harbor and coastal scenery of Le Havre became important themes in his early works.

points.title: 艺术探索
points.description: 1859年，莫奈前往巴黎学习艺术，但很快厌倦了传统学院派的绘画方式。他在巴黎结识了未来印象派的重要成员，包括雷诺阿、西斯莱和巴齐耶等。1862年，他进入查尔斯·格莱尔(Charles Gleyre)的工作室，但不久便离开，与同伴们一起探索新的艺术表现手法。这一时期，莫奈创作了《花园中的女人们》(Femmes au jardin)，完全在室外完成，摒弃了传统的黑色轮廓，使用纯色表现光影变化。1865-1866年间，他创作了《印象·日出》(Impression, Sunrise)，这幅作品后来成为印象派的开山之作，也是印象派名称的由来。
points.descriptionEn: In 1859, Monet moved to Paris to study art but soon grew tired of traditional academic painting methods. In Paris, he met future Impressionist members including Renoir, Sisley, and Bazille. In 1862, he entered Charles Gleyre's studio but left shortly after to explore new artistic techniques with his companions. During this period, he created 'Femmes au jardin,' completed entirely outdoors, abandoning traditional black outlines in favor of pure colors to depict light and shadow. Between 1865-1866, he painted 'Impression, Sunrise,' a work that later became the cornerstone of Impressionism and gave the movement its name.

points.title: 印象派黄金期
points.description: 1867年，莫奈在阿让特伊定居，这是他艺术生涯中最为高产和创新的时期之一。他租下了一座带有花园的房子，并建造了一个小型画室。在这里，莫奈创作了大量描绘塞纳河畔风光的作品，如《喜鹊》(La Pie)、《花园中的女人们》(Femmes au jardin)等。1870年代，印象派团体逐渐形成，莫奈成为其中的核心人物。1874年，他参与组织了第一次印象派画展，展出《印象·日出》等作品。1878年，莫奈与第一任妻子卡米尔在阿让特伊生下第二个儿子，但卡米尔同年因病去世。这一时期的莫奈作品色彩明亮，笔触自由，捕捉光线变化的技巧达到了新的高度。
points.descriptionEn: In 1867, Monet settled in Argenteuil, one of the most productive and innovative periods of his artistic career. He rented a house with a garden and built a small studio. Here, Monet created numerous works depicting the scenery along the Seine River, such as 'La Pie' and 'Femmes au jardin.' During the 1870s, the Impressionist group took shape, with Monet as a central figure. In 1874, he helped organize the first Impressionist exhibition, showing works including 'Impression, Sunrise.' In 1878, Monet and his first wife Camille had their second son in Argenteuil, but Camille died of illness the same year. During this period, Monet's works featured bright colors, free brushstrokes, and reached new heights in capturing light changes.

points.title: 花园创作
points.description: 1883年，莫奈在吉维尼租下了一座房子，后来购买了这座房产并开始精心设计他的著名花园。莫奈对园艺有着浓厚兴趣，他亲自设计并种植了各种花卉，特别是睡莲和日本桥，这些后来成为他晚期作品的重要主题。1889年，莫奈在巴黎世界博览会上举办了个人回顾展，获得了巨大成功。这一时期，他的作品风格更加成熟，色彩运用更加大胆，开始创作系列作品，如《干草堆》(Haystacks)和《白杨树》(Poplars)，通过在不同光线和季节下描绘同一主题，探索光线与色彩的变化。
points.descriptionEn: In 1883, Monet rented a house in Giverny, which he later purchased and began to meticulously design his famous garden. Monet had a keen interest in gardening and personally designed and planted various flowers, especially water lilies and Japanese bridges, which later became important themes in his late works. In 1889, Monet held a major retrospective at the Paris World Exposition, achieving great success. During this period, his artistic style became more mature with bolder color use, and he began creating series such as 'Haystacks' and 'Poplars,' exploring changes in light and color by depicting the same subject under different lighting conditions and seasons.

points.title: 睡莲系列
points.description: 1890年代开始，莫奈开始创作他最为著名的《睡莲》系列。他扩建了自己的花园，建造了一个专门用于绘画的大画室。1900年，他在巴黎的杜兰-鲁埃尔画廊举办大型展览，展出《干草堆》和《白杨树》系列，获得巨大成功。1911年，第二任妻子爱丽丝去世，给莫奈带来沉重打击。1914年，第一次世界大战爆发，长子让在前线受伤。尽管面临个人困境，莫奈在这一时期创作了大量《睡莲》作品，这些作品尺寸越来越大，构图越来越抽象，色彩越来越丰富。1916年，莫奈与法国政府达成协议，捐赠一系列《睡莲》作品给国家，这些后来被安置在橘园美术馆。
points.descriptionEn: Beginning in the 1890s, Monet started creating his most famous 'Water Lily' series. He expanded his garden and built a large studio specifically for painting. In 1900, he held a major exhibition at the Durand-Ruel gallery in Paris, showing his 'Haystacks' and 'Poplars' series, achieving great success. In 1911, his second wife Alice died, dealing a heavy blow to Monet. In 1914, World War I broke out, and his eldest son Jean was wounded on the front lines. Despite personal hardships, Monet created numerous 'Water Lily' works during this period, which grew larger in size, more abstract in composition, and richer in color. In 1916, Monet reached an agreement with the French government to donate a series of 'Water Lily' works to the nation, which were later installed in the Musée de l'Orangerie.

points.title: 晚年杰作
points.description: 1917年后，莫奈的视力开始下降，白内障问题影响了他的绘画能力。尽管如此，他仍然坚持创作，甚至在1923年接受手术后继续作画。这一时期，他的作品变得更加抽象和表现性，色彩运用更加大胆。1920年代，莫奈创作了《睡莲》系列的最后一批作品，这些作品被后人视为他艺术生涯的巅峰之作。1926年，86岁的莫奈在吉维尼去世，葬于当地教堂墓地。莫奈去世后，他的吉维尼故居和花园被保存下来，成为重要的文化遗址，每年吸引大量艺术爱好者参观。莫奈的艺术遗产对后世产生了深远影响，被视为现代艺术的先驱之一。
points.descriptionEn: After 1917, Monet's vision began to decline due to cataracts, affecting his ability to paint. Nevertheless, he continued to create, even resuming painting after surgery in 1923. During this period, his works became more abstract and expressive with bolder color use. In the 1920s, Monet created the final batch of his 'Water Lily' series, which are now considered the pinnacle of his artistic career. In 1926, 86-year-old Monet died in Giverny and was buried in the local cemetery. After his death, his home and garden in Giverny were preserved as an important cultural site, attracting numerous art enthusiasts annually. Monet's artistic legacy has had a profound influence on later generations, establishing him as one of the pioneers of modern art.

appraisal.zh: 莫奈被公认为印象派的奠基人与现代艺术的关键人物，他坚持户外写生，捕捉光线与色彩的瞬间变化，改变了西方绘画的走向，《睡莲》系列更成为文化符号并影响后世抽象艺术。不过也有研究者指出，他晚期作品因视力衰退而质量参差，对同一主题的反复描绘显出创造力减退，其商业成功亦被另一种看法视为对艺术纯粹性的妥协。
appraisal.en: Monet is widely recognized as the founder of Impressionism and a key figure in modern art, whose plein air practice and pursuit of fleeting light and color changed the course of Western painting, while the Water Lilies became a cultural symbol influencing later abstract art. Yet some researchers note that his late works vary in quality due to failing eyesight, that repeated treatment of the same subjects suggests waning invention, and another view holds his commercial success a compromise of artistic purity.

supporter.zh: 莫奈是印象派的奠基人和灵魂人物，他彻底改变了西方绘画的走向。他坚持户外写生，捕捉光线与色彩的瞬间变化，开创了现代绘画的新纪元。莫奈的艺术探索精神和对自然的热爱，使他成为艺术史上最具创新精神的画家之一。他的《睡莲》系列被视为艺术史上最伟大的作品之一，影响了后来的抽象艺术和现代主义。莫奈不仅是一位伟大的画家，更是一位革命者，他打破了传统绘画的束缚，为后世艺术家开辟了新的表现可能性。
supporter.en: Monet is the founder and soul of Impressionism, fundamentally changing the course of Western painting. By insisting on plein air painting and capturing the instantaneous changes of light and color, he pioneered a new era in modern art. Monet's spirit of artistic exploration and love for nature make him one of the most innovative painters in art history. His 'Water Lily' series is considered one of the greatest in art history, influencing later abstract art and modernism. Monet was not only a great painter but also a revolutionary who broke the constraints of traditional painting, opening up new possibilities for future artists.

critic.zh: 批评者认为莫奈的作品过于注重表面效果而缺乏深度，他的绘画技巧虽然创新但内容空洞。一些评论家指出，莫奈晚年作品因视力下降而质量参差不齐，部分作品显得粗糙和草率。此外，莫奈的商业成功也被一些艺术评论家视为对艺术纯粹性的妥协，他迎合市场需求的倾向被批评为艺术家的堕落。还有人认为，莫奈对同一主题的反复描绘显示出创造力的枯竭，特别是他晚期的《睡莲》系列被认为缺乏早期作品的活力和新鲜感。
critic.en: Critics argue that Monet's works focus too much on superficial effects while lacking depth. Some art critics point out that his later works, affected by declining vision, vary in quality, with some appearing rough and careless. Additionally, Monet's commercial success has been viewed by some art critics as a compromise to artistic purity, with his tendency to cater to market demands criticized as the corruption of an artist. Others believe that Monet's repeated depictions of the same subject indicate creative exhaustion, with his late 'Water Lily' series considered to lack the vitality and freshness of his earlier works.

objective.zh: 在历史学界和流行文化中，莫奈被公认为现代艺术的关键人物。他的艺术革命不仅改变了绘画技法，更影响了人们对艺术本质的理解。莫奈的名字与印象派紧密相连，成为艺术创新的代名词。他的吉维尼花园和睡莲作品已成为文化符号，代表着对自然美的追求和艺术与自然的和谐。莫奈的艺术遗产超越了单纯的绘画领域，影响了建筑、设计和时尚等多个领域。在当代，莫奈的作品被全球各大博物馆争相收藏，他的名字已成为艺术教育的核心内容，代表着艺术史上一个重要的转折点。
objective.en: In academic circles and popular culture, Monet is widely recognized as a key figure in modern art. His artistic revolution not only changed painting techniques but also influenced the understanding of the essence of art. Monet's name is inextricably linked to Impressionism, becoming synonymous with artistic innovation. His Giverny garden and water lily works have become cultural symbols, representing the pursuit of natural beauty and harmony between art and nature. Monet's artistic legacy extends beyond the realm of painting, influencing architecture, design, and fashion. Today, Monet's works are coveted by major museums worldwide, and his name has become a core component of art education, representing a significant turning point in art history.

self.zh: 我一生都在努力成为一个画家，但我很遗憾地发现，我永远无法画出我所看到的东西，我永远无法表达我所感受到的东西。
self.en: I have been always, always, always trying to paint the sky of France. I have finally captured it. My old enemies, the cypresses and the roses, are finally reconciled. I am at peace.
